# Light Embassy Church

> A worldwide Christian church offering followers a unified space for worship, learning, prayer, and spiritual community.

Light Embassy is a global community of followers of Christ revealing the Bible, discovering truth, and living the best life. The app provides sermons, podcasts, Bible study, prayer wall, community forum, and live radio.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Welcome, daily inspiration, and quick access to all features.
- [Watch](/watch): Sermons, teachings, and video content from Light Embassy.
- [Learn](/learn): Bible study tools, scripture reading, and saved verses.
- [Podcast](/podcast): Audio teachings and episodes with quizzes.
- [Prayers](/prayers): Submit prayer requests and pray for the community.
- [Messages](/messages): Conversations with the Light Embassy team.
